title: Boy with Red Rat
description: A surreal portrait of a young boy with cracked porcelain-like skin leaking golden fluid, a bright red rat perched on his shoulder. The background shows a desert landscape with sand dunes, a lone walking figure, a large pink moon, and floating colorful cell-like organisms connected by golden cracks.
prompt: Surreal scene of a young boy with cracked porcelain face and body leaking molten gold, a vivid red rat sitting on his shoulder, set in a desert with sand dunes. A distant silhouette walks toward the horizon under a large cracked pink moon. Floating colorful translucent cell-like organisms in pink, green and blue connected by golden veins fill the sky.
